sourceContext: Human supersedes the prior publication gate. Implementar v3 is locally complete, but the overall Costa Clean current roadmap is not complete. Continue locally and autonomously through all remaining established roadmap work, including N5.4/N5.5, provider-path resolution, integrated Smart Expense Capture certification, dependency/security audit and any other required current-roadmap items. Dashboard Analytics remains parked future work. Do not publish application source until true project completion.
objective: Continue Costa Clean development from the completed Implementar v3 local baseline until every required item in the current canonical Costa Clean roadmap is factually audited, implemented or explicitly resolved, locally certified, documented and ready for one final publication approval. Do not stop at intermediate phase completion and do not publish application source before COSTA_CLEAN_PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES.
why: Implementar v3 has passed local QA and independent review, but the established Costa Clean roadmap still includes unfinished Smart Expense Capture work and potentially other required release/security items. The human explicitly wants a single autonomous local completion loop and exactly one final publication gate after the whole current roadmap is complete.
requiredFirstAction: Perform a factual local roadmap reconciliation before any new implementation.

Audit current branch, HEAD, worktree, local unpublished commits, dirty state, ORCHESTOR task/run/thread, Issue #15, Issue #22, N5 Smart Expense Capture docs/evidence, N5.1/N5.2/N5.3 evidence, current/post-V3 roadmap docs, release-readiness docs, relevant open issues, relevant branches, parked tasks and dependency/security debt.
Do not rely on conversation memory when repository evidence is available.
Preserve the completed Implementar v3 work and all valid local commits. Do not reset, clean, discard, overwrite, silently rebase or reuse the Dashboard Analytics lane.
Persist a factual inventory with COMPLETED_PHASES, IN_PROGRESS_PHASES, NOT_STARTED_PHASES, BLOCKED_PHASES, PARKED_PHASES and UNKNOWN_OR_STALE_PHASES.
Do not declare project completion while any required item remains IN_PROGRESS, NOT_STARTED, BLOCKED or UNKNOWN.
knownRequiredRoadmapItems: N5.4 Supplier Identity + Duplicate Intelligence is unfinished and must be audited/implemented/certified.
N5.5 Human Confirmation + Safe Expense Persistence is unfinished and must be audited/implemented/certified.

Real document extraction provider/OCR/AI path must be audited. If already implemented, certify it. If incomplete, implement the safest provider-compatible path that preserves N5.2/N5.3 deterministic contracts. Provider output is evidence/proposal only, never accounting authority.
Integrated end-to-end Smart Expense Capture must be certified after N5.4 and N5.5.
Audit all other required current-roadmap items; do not assume N5.4/N5.5/provider are the only remaining work.
Audit npm/dependency advisories separately and classify exploitability/reachability/dev-only/fix availability/breaking-upgrade requirement. Do not blindly run npm audit fix --force.
n54Requirements: Supplier Master/canonical supplier identity where the factual architecture requires persistence.
Supplier matching from normalized N5.3 evidence while preserving N5.2 extraction and N5.3 normalized evidence unchanged.
Conservative name matching and explicit ambiguity handling.
No automatic identity invention and no silent merges.
Duplicate expense/document detection using exact deterministic signals before fuzzy/similarity signals.
Stable reason codes and human-review-required outcomes.
No financial write merely because a match exists.
Security/RLS implications designed and tested if persistence is required.
n55Requirements: Final user review surface for corrected/confirmed fields.
Explicit user confirmation before any financial persistence.
Transactional final expense creation with attachment/document/supplier linkage.
One confirmation produces at most one expense.
Double-submit protection, idempotent confirmation, crash/retry safety and atomic transaction boundaries.
Defined failure/rollback semantics and audit trail.
Authorization/RLS and no silent financial writes.
Authenticated QA certification and exact fixture cleanup.
phaseExecutionPolicy: For each unfinished phase: factual prestate -> requirements/acceptance criteria -> architecture -> implementation -> focused tests -> full regression -> lint -> typecheck -> build -> diff-check -> security/integrity -> authenticated QA where applicable -> independent review -> repair all actionable P0/P1/P2 -> retest -> rereview -> versioned evidence -> canonical documentation update -> local checkpoint/final commit -> automatically continue to next unfinished phase.
Ordinary technical failures that are safely repairable inside scope are not HUMAN_REQUIRED.
Do not require the human to manually paste routine repair prompts.
Local commits are allowed and expected; maintain clear phase commits.
Application source remains unpushed until true project completion.
documentationPolicy: Do not create endless duplicate status documents.
Historical evidence must remain historical; never rewrite an old certification as if it ran against new code.
Preserve exact implementation SHA and evidence SHA separately when needed.
Global roadmap must truthfully classify DONE, IN_PROGRESS, NOT_STARTED, BLOCKED, PARKED and DEFERRED.
dashboardAnalyticsPolicy: Preserve its task, thread, run, worktree, branch and commits.
Do not execute new Dashboard Analytics turns during this command.
Do not merge Dashboard Analytics into N5 or reuse its lane.
After core roadmap/Smart Expense Capture completion, report Dashboard Analytics separately as PARKED_FUTURE_PRODUCT_WORK unless factual roadmap evidence establishes it as a required blocker.
dependencyAuditPolicy: Classify each advisory as exploitable/relevant, transitive but reachable, transitive non-reachable, dev-only, false/non-applicable, fix available, or breaking upgrade required.
Do not use npm audit fix --force.
Do not introduce uncontrolled major dependency upgrades.
Relevant P0/P1 security issues are release blockers and must be fixed before PROJECT_COMPLETE.
Lower-severity dependency debt may be deferred only if independent security review confirms it is non-blocking.
requiredApprovals: Any new paid provider, billing activation, external provider contract or API credential/secret entry.
Any Supabase remote schema/data/Auth/Storage/Edge mutation not already separately authorized.
Any Production action or unavoidable Production access.
Any secret, credential, DNS, billing, payment or real external communication.
Any irreconcilable branch/worktree/ownership decision risking loss of user work.
Final application publication only after COSTA_CLEAN_PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES.
humanGateBehavior: If provider integration requires paid API/billing/API key/production secret/external contract, mark only that substep HUMAN_REQUIRED_PROVIDER_SECRET_OR_BILLING and continue every other safe provider-independent task.
If an authenticated QA step needs a human login/MFA, stop that specific step as QA_LOGIN_REQUIRED but continue other safe independent work when possible.
Do not stop the whole project for ordinary technical problems.
Do not request publication approval after intermediate phases.
trueProjectCompleteDefinition: Real extraction/provider path completed or explicitly resolved under approved architecture.
Integrated Smart Expense Capture E2E PASS.
Every other required current-roadmap item audited and resolved.
Authenticated responsive QA PASS where relevant.
Canonical docs, roadmap and release-readiness current.
Exact merge impact and production trigger behavior known.
finalIntegratedCertification: Run against the exact final local HEAD.
Network environment isolation and zero Production traffic from QA.
Independent final review with P0=0, P1=0, P2=0.
stopConditions: A genuine human-only gate is required: provider secret/billing/contract, interactive credential/MFA, destructive remote action, legally/business-sensitive decision not already specified, unavoidable Production action, or irreconcilable ownership/branch ambiguity risking user work.
No unique safe project/task/thread/worktree ownership can be established after bounded audit.
Valid local work cannot be preserved without destructive/ambiguous action.
A required phase cannot progress further locally and every other independent roadmap item is also exhausted.
Final project completion criteria are all satisfied, in which case stop at the single final publication approval gate.
verificationRequirements: Persist factual roadmap inventory before new implementation.
Report exact local branch, start HEAD, worktree, local-only commits and dirty state.
Report thread/run disposition for this command and preserve completed V3 evidence.
Report Dashboard Analytics as PAUSED_BY_USER/PARKED with zero new turns.
For each phase report implementation SHA, evidence SHA, focused/full tests, lint, typecheck, build, diff, security/integrity, QA and independent review.
For dependency audit report advisory classification and release-blocking disposition without uncontrolled upgrades.
For provider path report factual implementation state and any human-only secret/billing gate separately.
For integrated Smart Expense Capture report all required scenario outcomes, financial/data invariants, cross-user/unauthorized checks and cleanup residue.
Before final publication gate run full integrated certification against exact final local HEAD.
Report APPLICATION_PUSH=0, PR_MUTATIONS=0, MERGES=0, DEPLOYS=0, PRODUCTION_MUTATIONS=0 until true project completion.
Final output must be COSTA_CLEAN_PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES with FINAL_STATE=LOCAL_PROJECT_COMPLETE / HUMAN_FINAL_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, or a genuine unresolved human-only gate with exact reason.
